summary:
LIVE MODEL (pddl/domain_pddlstream.pddl + pddl/stream.pddl, loaded by pddlstream_planner.py:177-178). Predicates: type markers Boxel/Obj/Config/Trajectory/Grasp; classification is_shadow/is_object/is_free_space; static geometry blocks_view_at(?obj ?b ?region); derived blocks_view, view_blocked, view_clear (view_clear = is_shadow AND NOT view_blocked, domain:101-113); location obj_at_boxel and the single Know-If fluent obj_at_boxel_KIF; robot at_config/handempty/holding/obj_pose_known; stream-certified valid_grasp, motion, kin_solution, config_for_boxel, stack_kin; init-computed boxel_fits, on_surface, placement_hides, marginally_blocked (diagnostic, nothing consumes it); stacking on/on_table/clear/is_tray. Actions and costs: sense 1, move 1, pick 1, place 1, place_hiding 2, stack 3. Streams: sample-grasp, plan-motion, compute-kin, compute-stack-kin (stream.pddl:4-40); boxel_fits is deliberately NOT a stream (stream.pddl:19-21, planner:812-814). SENSE semantics (domain:169-191): params (?o ?region); preconditions Obj, Boxel, handempty, view_clear(region), NOT obj_at_boxel_KIF(o, region), boxel_fits(o, region); effects assert KIF, obj_at_boxel (optimistic found) and obj_pose_known. handempty was added 2026-08-21 because sensing while holding is physically self-blocked and only a precondition can force place-before-sense (domain:158-168). boxel_fits for sense means hideability: --sense-gate off emits it for every (object, fragment) pair, strict only where a sought-class box can rest fully occluded (streams.test_target_can_hide_in_shadow, streams.py:576-688). The sense action takes no config parameter: the camera is fixed and external (streams.py:8-9, methods.tex:170).

INIT CONSTRUCTION (_build_init, planner:582-938): every SHADOW boxel gets is_shadow; known_empty shadows get KIF for each target; OBJECT boxels get obj_at_boxel/KIF on themselves (except the held object) and KIF for every target (whole table observed, audit #67); every registered object gets KIF for every fragment (planner:691-694, so only objects WITHOUT a boxel can be searched for); blocks_view_at(blocker, blocker, shadow) from shadow_occluder_map (the render census, execution.compute_shadow_blockers:286-450, criterion: an object is a blocker if removing it is needed to bring every sense slice under SENSE_MARGINAL_BLOCKED_FRACTION 0.05); placement-corridor facts blocks_view_at(obj, free_cell, shadow) from _compute_placement_view_blocks (pair criterion at 0.05 plus per-object egregious virtual boxes at PLACEMENT_EGREGIOUS_BLOCKED_FRACTION 0.15); placement_hides from _compute_placement_hides; boxel_fits(o, free) gated by REACH_LIMIT_M and ee_reachable; boxel_fits(o, shadow) by sense_gate; init is shuffled. OBSERVATION TO FLUENTS: the loop (test_full_pipeline.py:1209-1351) passes known_empty = not_here + parked(unresolved) shadows (1217-1218) and held_obj; handle_sense_action (execution.py:2412-2841) renders ONE fixed-camera depth+seg image, classifies the shared sense grid (perception.sense_ray_slices: dense low slice at base+0.02 m with 12 mm spacing plus two 7x7 slices) into found_target / still_blocked / contains_nontarget / clear_but_empty (execution.py:94-102). found: belief.mark_sensed(found=True), target OBJECT boxel registered from the render estimate (2537-2612). clear_but_empty or contains_nontarget: mark_sensed(False), fragment removed, discovered bodies registered with their own shadows, every other fragment swept against the same render (2767-2841). still_blocked: partial-reveal shrink to the blocked box, strike counter, three strikes mark not_here (unsound by the thesis's own admission, methods.tex:168). Unlocalizable content parks the fragment unresolved (2718-2736). register_new_detections registers any newly visible body, the target included (then directly pickable, 2255-2384).

SHADOW GEOMETRY (shadow_calculator.py:55-327): 2.5-D, cast from the fixed camera: back corners of the occluder box are projected along camera rays onto the table (rayTestBatch), the hit-point AABB is unioned with the occluder box, clamped to the table, the occluder is subtracted along the dominant HORIZONTAL axis (the footprint itself is never part of the shadow), an optional two-slab carve applies when the lateral overhang hits an obstacle, then plain six-way AABB subtraction of every obstacle (objects and earlier shadows, audit #68 cross-carve). Fragments: registered as shadow_of_<caster>[__NN] with created_by_boxel_id (boxel_env.generate_boxels:1505-1541; mid-episode via register_new_detections). Shrunk by _shrink_shadow_fragment on still_blocked; retired on clear/contains observations, by retire_lost_objects when the caster vanished and the fragment renders empty, or by three strikes. Discovery: found_target registers the target OBJECT boxel at the render estimate; KIF emission then removes it from the searchable set.

SHADOW-SPECIFIC vs GENERIC: the planner, the belief (BeliefState: a status per fragment id, belief.py:40-121), the census, the corridor facts, the sense classifier and the partial-reveal shrink are all generic over 'a SHADOW-typed AABB with a caster id'. Only calculate_shadow_boxel's ray construction and the strict-gate 'lifted fragment' test (requires z_min at table_z, streams.py:639-645) encode lateral occlusion. Nothing downstream requires the fragment to be behind its caster.

TAMPURA SIDE (read-only): the die is hidden INSIDE an upside-down concave cup at the same XY (problems/*.json, 3 files; env_generator.py:123-127, 164-180 rejects scenes where the wrist camera at DEFAULT_ARM_POS sees the die). Their belief is a 15 mm table-surface voxel grid (env.py:36, 240-269); voxels inside any KNOWN object's collision mesh are cleared (env.py:222-237), so a concave cup's interior voxels stay 'occupied' and remain die candidates: containment is represented by them as 'unseen table surface not occupied by a known solid', using the known category mesh. Their look action moves the wrist camera near the moved cup's original pose and succeeds with probability new_seen/occupied voxels (env.py:471-520, 584-680); look depends on moved(?o2) and Not(holding) (env.py:962-977); pick requires known-pose and Not(moved) (each object moved at most once); reward = holding(die) AND at-home (993-1004). Their perception takes the ground-truth pose of any body present in the seg mask (env.py:64-75).

OPTIONS FOR CONTAINMENT. (a) CONTAINMENT FRAGMENT: emit an extra SHADOW BoxelData per qualifying occluder covering its footprint from table_z to its estimated top, created_by the occluder, registered and wired exactly like a lateral fragment (belief.add_shadow, shadow_occluder_map[frag] = [caster], shadows list). Planner unchanged, streams unchanged, PDDL unchanged: the census lists the cup as blocker (all endpoints intercepted by its rendered surface), blocks_view_at(cup, cup, under) pins view_blocked until the cup leaves its boxel; handempty forces a place first; corridor facts forbid placing the cup where it would re-block the footprint; the executed sense renders the old footprint and finds the die (dense slice) or marks the region empty. Seed-generic, generalizes to any 'interior region revealed by relocating its cover' (3D Wumpus: a region behind a door). Thesis claims change by one sentence: the hidden-region vocabulary gains the interior region the conclusion already names as future work (conclusion.tex:41-42); methods.tex:138 (hidden iff every corner's line of sight is blocked) already covers it. Sub-choice WHICH objects cast one: (a1) every object (honest 'interior unobserved', but changes thesis-scene behaviour: 3-4 cm target boxes fit inside 13 cm occluder footprints, so the planner would relocate cubes to look under them; a flag defaulting off for our scenes is configuration, not solution encoding, provided the bridge uses one setting for all 20 seeds); (a2) objects whose task-declared category property says 'may cover' (parity with TAMPURA's use of the known category mesh; the property must be declared as task knowledge like NOMINAL_HIDDEN_EXTENTS, never as a string match on 'cup' inside pipeline code). (b) A NEW REGION TYPE 'under(cup)' with its own covers/region_covered predicates: strictly redundant with blocks_view_at + view_clear; costs a domain edit and a derived predicate for no planning benefit; only reporting value, which a BoxelData field (region_kind) gives for free. (c) LIFT-AND-LOOK or sense-while-holding: contradicts the handempty gate and the 2026-08-21 field evidence (held object and arm in the ray cone, 100 percent self-blocked); with a wrist camera the held cup hangs under the lens, so it is self-defeating there too; a hold-aside variant needs a new action, a hold-aside config stream and executor code, and reopens scripted-motion (H2) risk. Not recommended. (d) TAMPURA-style active look (sense with a config parameter certified by a viewpoint stream): a different sensing model (active perception), changes the thesis's 'fixed camera, sense calls no streams' claim; out of scope unless designers want viewpoint parity. (e) CAMERA PLACEMENT, orthogonal to (a): either the fixed eye is their wrist camera at DEFAULT_ARM_POS (archived D4), which requires sense to carry (at_config ?q)+(sense_config ?q) and a planned move home (init facts (Boxel home)+(config_for_boxel q_home home) mirror the tray trick at planner:802-805), or an external camera is added to their world, which changes what counts as hidden relative to their generator's wrist-camera check. The former is comparable; the latter must be flagged.

TUNABLES (section 5) are in design_relevant_details with an honest/hidden classification; the sense-grid and class-size constants are calibrated for 3-4 cm targets and the die is about 2.2 cm, so they must be re-derived from the declared target class before any run, once, documented.

facts.claim: The live domain has six actions with costs sense 1, move 1, pick 1, place 1, place_hiding 2, stack 3, and the four streams sample-grasp, plan-motion, compute-kin, compute-stack-kin.

sense preconditions are Obj, Boxel, handempty, view_clear(region), not obj_at_boxel_KIF(o, region), boxel_fits(o, region); effects are obj_at_boxel_KIF, obj_at_boxel (optimistic found), obj_pose_known, cost 1.
view_clear is derived as is_shadow AND NOT view_blocked, with view_blocked derived from obj_at_boxel + the static blocks_view_at; actions never touch view predicates directly.
The handempty precondition on sense was added 2026-08-21 because sensing with a held object is self-blocked in the fixed camera's ray cone and no cost assignment can order place before sense.
boxel_fits for sense is an init fact whose meaning depends on --sense-gate: off emits it for every (object, fragment) pair, strict only where test_target_can_hide_in_shadow passes.

test_target_can_hide_in_shadow rejects fragments whose z_min is above table_z (lifted) and samples resting positions on a 10 mm grid, casting rays to all 8 corners of a class-size box; the class size is NOMINAL_HIDDEN_EXTENTS_MIN 0.03 m for unregistered targets.
_build_init emits obj_at_boxel_KIF for every registered OBJECT boxel against every shadow, so only objects without a registry boxel can be the ?o of a groundable sense.
blocks_view_at facts come from shadow_occluder_map keyed to the blocker's own OBJECT boxel; the held object's location facts are dropped so it stops blocking its own fragment while carried.

Placement-corridor facts blocks_view_at(obj, free_cell, shadow) are computed geometrically from the camera to the fragment's sense slices with two criteria (cell AABB at 0.05, per-object virtual box at PLACEMENT_EGREGIOUS_BLOCKED_FRACTION 0.15), switchable by --corridor-test.

The census compute_shadow_blockers lists an object as a blocker of a fragment only if removing it is needed to bring every sense slice's blocked fraction under SENSE_MARGINAL_BLOCKED_FRACTION 0.05, using one rendered depth+seg image; a parent fallback applies only while the caster's box still touches the fragment.

plan() calls pddlstream solve(algorithm='adaptive', max_time, unit_costs, planner, search_sample_ratio); default planner 'ff-astar2', SEARCH_SAMPLE_RATIO 0.25, max_plan_time default 1800 s; the returned plan is converted to tuples without any edit.

The sense executor classifies the fragment against one fixed-camera render into found_target, still_blocked, contains_nontarget, clear_but_empty, with per-slice blocked fractions and a 5 percent marginal tolerance.

found_target registers the target as an OBJECT boxel from the same render estimate; clear_but_empty/contains_nontarget mark not_here, remove the fragment and sweep every other fragment against the same render; still_blocked shrinks the fragment to the blocked box and burns a strike, three strikes retire it as not_here; unlocalizable content parks the fragment unresolved after three strikes.

register_new_detections registers any body visible in a sense render that has no boxel, casts shadows for non-targets, adds every new fragment to the belief as unknown, and makes a newly visible target directly pickable with no sense.
The loop withholds not_here and parked (unresolved) fragments from the planner as known_empty_shadows and passes held_obj so replans continue from (holding o).

Shadows are 2.5-D: back corners of the occluder are projected along fixed-camera rays onto the table, the AABB is clamped to the table, the occluder is subtracted along the dominant horizontal axis so the footprint is never inside the shadow, then every obstacle (objects and earlier shadows) is subtracted by six-way AABB difference.
An object whose base is more than 1 cm above the table casts no shadow (held or mid-air objects).
Fragments are named shadow_of_<caster>[__NN] with created_by_boxel_id set, and every table point belongs to at most one SHADOW boxel by construction (cross-shadow carve).
BeliefState is a per-fragment status dict (unknown/not_here/found/unresolved) with add_shadow/remove_shadow/mark_sensed/mark_unresolved and no geometry.

Free space is an octree over the workspace with OBJECT and SHADOW boxels as obstacles, min_resolution 0.035 m, merged by face-adjacent greedy merging; reboxelize diffs and re-registers only changed cells.

The thesis models sense as optimistic with reactive replanning, calls no streams for sense because the camera is fixed, and names the interior of concave geometry (containers, cupboards) as a hidden region left for future work.
The thesis states a target counts as hidden only when the camera's line of sight to every corner of its bounding box is blocked, which containment under a cup satisfies.

The archived bridge domains (domain_find_dice.pddl: pick/place relaxed to drop all streams, teleport execution; domain_find_dice_streamful.pddl: streams kept, sense without boxel_fits, go_home + at_home added) are both ARCHIVED with the discarded bridge and are not loaded by the live planner.
The archived bridge's open blockers were (f) containment regions not modelled and (g) an unplanned arm park before each sense.

TAMPURA's find_dice belief is a 15 mm voxel grid over the table surface; voxels seen by the wrist camera are cleared and voxels inside any known object's collision mesh (concave YCB meshes, use_concave=True) are cleared, so the hollow interior of an upside-down cup stays a die candidate.

TAMPURA's look action looks for ?o1 behind ?o2 from a sampled wrist-camera conf 0.2-0.3 m above ?o2 with N(0, 0.1) XY jitter, depends on moved(?o2), requires Not(holding), and succeeds with probability new_seen/occupied voxels.
TAMPURA's pick requires Not(moved ?o) and known-pose; place sets moved; go-home requires holding; reward is holding(die) AND at-home.
TAMPURA's perception assigns the ground-truth world pose to any body whose id appears in the segmentation mask.
find_dice has exactly 3 problem files; get_scene_data picks one with random.choice; the seed-to-file mapping of the local sweep is logged as 'Loading scene from <file>' in each seed console log.

In the three problem files the die sits at the same XY as a cup (two files exactly, one within 1.5 cm) at z 0.02085, i.e. half-height about 0.0108 m after the generator's +0.01 drop margin (table top at z = 0), so the die is about 2.2 cm; cups are 7-8.5 cm tall.
The generator saves a scene only if the die is absent from the wrist camera's segmentation at DEFAULT_ARM_POS, so 'hidden' in find_dice means hidden from that wrist viewpoint.

Our sense-grid constants assume targets of at least 3 cm: the dense slice sits 0.02 m above the fragment base and its 12 mm spacing is derived from a 3 cm footprint; the render depth tolerance is 3 mm.
REACH_LIMIT_M 0.80 and the reach sphere (R 0.815, centre at WORLD z 0.066) were measured on our table height and base pose and gate both compute_kin and the placement-candidate facts.
GRASP_MAX_SPAN is 0.076 m (Panda 0.04 per finger minus 2 mm clearance each side); TAMPURA's OPEN_GRIPPER_POS is 0.045 per finger and its grasps come from a saved library (GRASP_MODE 'saved').

The pipeline's CLI exposes --planner (ff-astar1/ff-astar2/ff-astar/ff-wastar1/ff-wastar2/dijkstra), --unit-costs, --search-sample-ratio, --sense-gate, --corridor-test, and max_plan_time; a post-planning plan rewrite was tried and withdrawn on the user's directive.

The loop's holding success is held_body_id equal to the target body plus a physics check; goal_satisfied supports only holding/on/on_table/and heads, so an at-home conjunct needs a goal-evaluator extension.

design_relevant_details: Interface for a new fragment (copy register_new_detections, execution.py:2356-2373): BoxelData(boxel_type=SHADOW, min_corner, max_corner, created_by_object=name, created_by_boxel_id=name, on_surface='table' if min z <= table_z+0.01, surface_z=table_z); registry.add_boxel(sp) (auto id shadow_NNN unless sp.id set); caster.shadow_boxel_ids.append(id); shadows.append(id); shadow_occluder_map[id] = [caster]; boxel_centers[id] = sp.center; belief.add_shadow(id); registry._dirty = True so the free-space octree re-carves.

Containment fragment geometry for option (a): min = (obj_min_x, obj_min_y, table_z), max = (obj_max_x, obj_max_y, obj_max_z) of the perception estimate (detect_objects_from_render already snaps the box bottom to the support and completes the away-facing footprint, perception.py:322-335, 384-405). z_min must equal table_z (within 1e-3) or test_target_can_hide_in_shadow rejects it as lifted (streams.py:639-645).

Lateral shadow and containment fragment never overlap: calculate_shadow_boxel subtracts the occluder along the dominant horizontal axis (shadow_calculator.py:217-236), so the audit #68 invariant (each table point in at most one SHADOW boxel) survives if the containment fragment is bounded by the footprint.

Census behaviour for a containment fragment: every sense endpoint inside the footprint is intercepted by the caster's rendered top, so compute_shadow_blockers lists the caster as blocker; after relocation the fragment is clear unless another body stands in the corridor. No code change needed in the census.

Planner behaviour for option (a) with zero PDDL edits: blocks_view_at(cup, cup, under) + obj_at_boxel(cup, cup) derive view_blocked; pick removes obj_at_boxel so view_clear holds while holding, but sense needs handempty, so a place (or stack) must precede sense; corridor facts blocks_view_at(cup, free_X, under) forbid re-blocking placements; the F31 placement_hides facts forbid hiding other known bodies.

Option (a) sub-choice gate must be declared task knowledge, not scene knowledge: either a flag 'cast_interior_regions' applied to all objects (a1), or a per-category property supplied with the task spec (a2), e.g. may_cover(category). Never a substring test on 'cup' or a body id inside pipeline code (H4).

Option (b) exact edits if chosen anyway: predicates (covers ?obj ?region) static and (:derived (region_covered ?region) (exists (?obj ?b) (and (obj_at_boxel ?obj ?b) (covers ?obj ?region)))) and view_clear gains (not (region_covered ?region)); but blocks_view_at(cup, cup, region) already yields the same derivation, so (b) adds a predicate pair and grounding cost with no new behaviour.

Option (c) would need a new action lift(?o ?b ?g ?q) with effects (holding ?o) (not (obj_at_boxel ?o ?b)) and a sense variant without handempty, plus a hold-aside config stream; it conflicts with domain:158-168 and the 2026-08-21 field evidence (100 percent self-blocked senses while holding).

Option (e) wrist-camera-as-fixed-eye edits: sense gains (Config ?q) (at_config ?q) (sense_config ?q); init adds (Config q_home) (sense_config q_home) plus (Boxel home) (config_for_boxel q_home home) so the existing move action can plan a motion home via plan-motion (mirrors the tray's (Boxel tray) trick, pddlstream_planner.py:802-805); the goal becomes ('and', ('holding', die), ('at_config', q_home)) and goal_satisfied (test_full_pipeline.py:106-135) needs an at_config head verified against joint positions. No new fluent, no go_home action.

Thesis sentence that changes under option (a): methods.tex:157 says relocating an occluder spawns no new shadow; a relocated cup also casts no new containment fragment (the robot carried it, the die stayed), so this stays true. Add one sentence that interior regions of covering objects are hidden regions cast by the cover, revealed by relocating it; conclusion.tex:41-42 already lists this as the intended extension.

Target-class constants that must be re-derived from the die class (about 2.2 cm, verify against models/srl/ycb dice mesh): NOMINAL_HIDDEN_EXTENTS 0.04 (place fits), NOMINAL_HIDDEN_EXTENTS_MIN 0.03 (hideability), SENSE_LOW_SLICE_OFFSET 0.02 (must lie strictly inside the die: needs < 0.0216 minus SENSE_RENDER_DEPTH_TOL 0.003), SENSE_DENSE_SPACING 0.012 (must be < die footprint/2 about 0.011), FreeSpaceGenerator min_resolution 0.035 ('half the target size'). Set once from the declared class, record in the audit, never per seed.

Reach constants to re-measure for THEIR world (table top z = 0, TABLE_POSE (0.1, 0, -0.015), base pose per their setup_robot): REACH_LIMIT_M 0.80, REACH_SPHERE_R_M 0.815, REACH_SPHERE_CENTER_Z_WORLD 0.066 (a WORLD height, so it does not transfer). Re-measure with tools/_probe_reach_envelope.py on their empty table, not by hand.

Grasp span: GRASP_MAX_SPAN 0.076 (streams.py:719) versus cups 6-9 cm wide; a cup wider than the span is ungraspable top-down and the planner cannot relocate it (honest failure, reported as pick_giveup/no plan). Widening the span is honest only up to the gripper's real opening (their OPEN_GRIPPER_POS 0.045 per finger implies 0.09 minus clearance); importing TAMPURA's saved grasp library would change the thesis's top-down grasp model and must be an explicit, flagged decision.

Planner search configuration knobs and their honest setting: --planner default ff-astar2 (library default), --unit-costs off (domain costs place 1 / place_hiding 2 / stack 3), --search-sample-ratio 0.25, --sense-gate off or strict, --corridor-test cell+object, max_plan_time 1800 s. Honest: one value for all 20 seeds fixed before the sweep, same as the thesis sweep unless a documented reason tied to the task class exists; hidden encoding: any value chosen because it produced the cup-first plan on inspected seeds.

Observation outcomes after the cup is relocated and sense(die, under_cup) executes: found_target if any dense-slice endpoint inside the old footprint is intercepted by the die's rendered surface; clear_but_empty if all endpoints see the table; still_blocked if the arm or another body covers more than 5 percent of a slice (then shrink + strike); contains_nontarget if another body stands there. If the die becomes visible anywhere in the frame after the place, register_new_detections (execution.py:2255-2384) registers it from the next sense render and the KIF emission makes it directly pickable.

Belief and oracle diagnostics that will start naming containment fragments: the ORACLE line in test_full_pipeline.py:694-744 (target_to_shadow by AABB containment + grid_would_hit) is diagnostic only and feeds nothing; keep it that way.

Seed-for-seed scene loading: TAMPURA's get_scene_data uses Python random.choice over 3 JSON files after global seeding; the bridge must reproduce the same file per seed (the mapping is in wsl_tampura/sweep_consoles/seed_N.log line 4) rather than re-seeding differently; do not edit env.py.

TAMPURA success criterion to mirror: reward holding(die) AND at-home, where at-home is conf within 1e-4 of DEFAULT_ARM_POS (env.py:318-321) and holding is their belief's grasp; the bridge must verify physically (die in gripper contact, joints at DEFAULT_ARM_POS within tolerance) and count go-home motion failures as failures (CB#123).

Live-loop give-up rules that carry over unchanged and must be disclosed in the comparison: three still_blocked strikes mark a fragment not_here (unsound, methods.tex:168), three unlocalizable observations park it unresolved, three failed picks mark an object ungraspable with parole after 4 plans (test_full_pipeline.py:1220-1234).

Pipeline constants with their values for the record: SENSE_MARGINAL_BLOCKED_FRACTION 0.05, PLACEMENT_EGREGIOUS_BLOCKED_FRACTION 0.15, SEARCH_SAMPLE_RATIO 0.25, HIDE_GRID_SPACING 0.01, HIDE_GRID_MAX_PER_AXIS 12, _GRASP_Z_OFFSETS [0.10, 0.06], DETECTION_MIN_PIXELS 6, DETECTION_SUPPORT_SNAP 0.02, AABB_OVERLAP_EPS 1e-3, octree min_resolution 0.035, RRT 2000 iterations / 0.2 rad / 5 percent goal bias.
honesty_risks: Gating containment fragments by a code-level name match ('cups_ud', 'cup_0') or by a body id is scene-specific knowledge (H4). The gate must be a declared task property (a2) or apply to every object (a1), recorded in the audit with its effect on thesis scenes.

Casting a containment fragment ONLY for the cup that actually hides the die (read from their poses or problem JSON) is an oracle read (H1). The fragment set must be a function of the perception estimates and the declared class property alone.

Parking the arm at home before each sense in executor code (archived blocker (g)) is an unplanned motion (H2). If the eye is the wrist camera at home, the move home must be a planned action with a planned motion stream.

Adding an external fixed camera to their world changes what 'hidden' means relative to their generator's wrist-camera check and could make the die laterally visible in some seeds; this is a comparability change that must be flagged, not silently adopted.

Sense-grid and class-size constants calibrated for 3-4 cm cubes will misclassify a 2.2 cm die (dense slice 2 cm above the base with 3 mm depth tolerance may not see a 2.17 cm die; strict hideability uses a 3 cm box). Fixing them by looking at per-seed outcomes is solution encoding; deriving them once from the declared die class is configuration.

Choosing --planner, --unit-costs, --sense-gate, --corridor-test or search_sample_ratio per seed, or because a value yields the cup-first plan on inspected seeds, is hidden solution encoding; one pre-registered setting for all 20 seeds is configuration.

Re-using REACH_LIMIT_M / reach sphere values from our table in their world silently changes which placements are offered; hand-adjusting them until plans bind is tuning. Re-measure with the existing probe on their empty table and record the numbers.
Widening GRASP_MAX_SPAN or switching to TAMPURA's saved grasp library so cups become graspable changes the thesis's top-down grasp model; if done, it is a flagged model change, not a configuration.

The archived domain_find_dice.pddl removed streams from pick/place (teleport execution) and the streamful variant dropped boxel_fits from sense; reviving either file reintroduces discarded relaxations. Any find_dice domain must be the live domain plus the minimal additions listed here.

Marking the containment fragment not_here on any outcome other than an observation of the revealed footprint (for example when the cup is picked, before the sense) would be a belief lie; only the sense render may change its status.

register_new_detections and refresh_object_aabbs take the target's seg id from env.objects[target_name].object_id; this identity map is the accepted sim-grade recognition stand-in (execution.py:88-89) and matches TAMPURA's own seg-id perception, but their perception also returns ground-truth poses; our side must keep using render estimates, never their poses.

An implementer may be tempted to pre-sort or filter the plan (for example dropping a redundant place) when ff-astar2 returns a detour; nothing may edit the action sequence between solve() and the executor (H2, pddlstream_planner.py:991-994).

Success scoring must not read their belief or world poses; holding(die) and at-home must be verified from gripper contact and joint positions, with go-home failures counted (CB#123 in PAPER_AUDIT.txt:3190-3194).
open_questions: Which eye: the wrist camera at DEFAULT_ARM_POS as the fixed camera (comparable to their generator's hidden check, requires a planned move home before every sense) or an external camera (changes the task)? Designers must decide and record.
